_comment: (spec 5.5, the anchor-stone-per-region idiom) Each row is one fast-travel DESTINATION: {id, display_name, map, cell, requires_accomplishment, arrival_toast}.

portals.arrival_toast: Cold light, gone as fast as it came. The gate district's noise rushes back in around you.
portals._comment: Task 2.4, the DAY-ONE LISCOR LINK: this row and `the_wandering_inn` re-gate door_awakened -> door_mounted. The Magical Door carries the inn<->Liscor hop from the moment it is hung, and door_awakened now means 'reaches BEYOND Liscor', which is what the three region rows below still wait on. Old saves reach door_mounted through Task 2.6's backfill, so no shipped save loses a destination.

portals.arrival_toast: Warm air, woodsmoke, the creak of the pantry door settling shut behind you. You're back, and you didn't walk here.
portals._comment: Day-one Liscor link -- see liscor_street's row. Arrival cell (13,6) is one WEST of pantry_door (14,6) and clear of `pisces_mounting` (13,5), whose window closes at the very counter this row opens on.

portals.arrival_toast: The light warms and the air smells of wheat and river water before you've taken a step. Riverfarm, same as the rumor said.
portals._comment: Arrival cell (13,5), one east of riverfarm_anchor_stone (12,5) at the village's own end of the pair; open and off every blocked/decor/entity cell (blast-radius checked). GATE IS door_awakened, NOT riverfarm_attuned: the far link IS the door chain's payoff, and the old gate let a board rumor alone strand a player in a village whose only exit stone gated on the awakening. riverfarm_attuned keeps banking off the rumor as lore.

portals.arrival_toast: The light turns pale and cool, and the noise of a much bigger city rushes in to fill the silence. Invrisil, same as the letter promised.
portals._comment: Arrival cell (4,8), one east of invrisil_anchor_stone (3,8) at the boulevard's own end of the pair; open and off every blocked/decor/entity cell (blast-radius checked).

portals.arrival_toast: The light sharpens and the air turns to hot metal and stone dust. Pallass, tier on tier, rising past where you can see the top.
portals._comment: pallass_attuned banks from Krshia's attunement-stone purchase (data/dialogue/krshia_crate.json's 'charms' node, gated on pallass_sponsored), the SAME late-attuning shape as invrisil_attuned. Arrival cell (4,8), open floor one south of alchemy_bench_reduction (4,7) -- travel used to land ON that bench, so the player stood inside a solid prop and could never walk back onto the cell. data_lint's arrival-vs-blocking arm now refuses the whole class.

portals.arrival_toast: The light dims into torchlit stone, and the deep hush of the dungeon closes back around you. You know this quiet.
portals._comment: dungeon_attuned banks from sleep_beat.gd's second-door pair. Carrier `dungeon_wardstone` (2,5) gates on this counter -- it shipped one-way (GH#334 note 20).
